personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean fused with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A premium, unified consumer sports app that balances clear data hierarchy with layered, frosted glass surfaces for a frictionless and polished team experience.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and list components shouldn't be crowded. Padding is intentional to make tap targets large and clear.

do_s: Sticky headers over scrolling feeds (like Home and Groups lists).
Weather widget background layered over home screen hero.
dont_s: Every card or list row (use surfaceSecondary for those).
Form fields or body text regions.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A modular, personalized dashboard highlighting weather, next up events, and live activities before leading into the user's groups.

states.loading: Centered brand-colored spinner with skeleton loaders for the weather and next-event cards.
states.empty: Illustration of a sports field with a prompt 'Join or create your first team'. Primary CTA to 'Enter Group Code'.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard. 'Retry' button below a clear error message.

screens.layout: Vertical ScrollView. Top: SafeArea + Greeting ('Welcome back, JD') + frosted glass Weather widget showing current conditions. Below: 'Next Up' featured card (edge-to-edge gradient scrim over team photo). Middle: 'Live Activities' horizontal scroll list showing real-time scores (use mono font for scores). Bottom: Group cards in a single column layout. Primary sticky CTA 'Enter Group Code' overlaying the bottom tab bar if needed, or simply standard bottom tabs.

screens.name: Groups List & Hub
screens.purpose: A central hub to access all team-related communication, scheduling, and files.

states.empty: No groups yet. 'Find a Group' illustration + primary CTA.
states.error: Failed to load groups. Tap to refresh.

screens.layout: Groups List: Horizontal stream navigator at the top (like a tab row) to switch between different sports/teams. Group Hub Detail: Header features the team logo (real PNG) over a brand-tinted gradient. Grid of feature tiles (Chat, Schedule, Polls, Members) using space-between. In-app messaging is accessed via the Chat tile. Schedule uses a unified calendar view.

screens.name: Unified Schedule
screens.purpose: A combined calendar view for all team events with RSVP/Check-In actions.

states.empty: No upcoming events. 'Take a rest day' graphic.

screens.layout: Top calendar strip (horizontal scroll for dates). Below: Vertical list of Event Cards. Each card shows Date/Time, Title, Location, and an RSVP segmented control (Going/Maybe/No). Tapping opens Event Detail sheet with maps, live status, and volunteer coordination.

screens.name: Marketplace
screens.purpose: A clean, mobile-first feed for browsing and listing C2C sports gear without in-app payments.

states.empty: No listings yet. 'Be the first to list gear' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Dominant search bar with slide-up filter panel icon. Below: 2-column grid of product cards. Cards feature high-quality imagery, title, price, and one tag (e.g., 'Barely Used'). Sticky bottom FAB to 'Create Listing'. Details page focuses on imagery, specs, and a prominent 'Message Seller' CTA.

screens.name: Wallet & Profile
screens.purpose: A dashboard-style hub for managing rewards, coupons, referral links, and app settings.

states.empty: No rewards yet. 'Share your referral link to earn' CTA.

screens.layout: Top: Profile header with avatar, name, and total earned/saved points. Middle: Carousel of active rewards/coupons using rich graphics. Bottom: Vertical list for Settings (Notification prefs, Appearance toggle). Clear, distinct visual states for redeeming coupons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided; no blues, indigos, or purples. Use Emerald greens as the brand focus.

Implement glassmorphism (`expo-blur` or `expo-glass-effect`) on sticky headers, tab bars, and the Home screen weather widget. Ensure underlying content is readable by pairing blur with a translucent tinted base (>=70% opacity in light, >=75% in dark mode).
Ensure all images used as backgrounds (e.g., hero background, next up events) have a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim to guarantee text readability.
Use JetBrains Mono or similar mono-spaced font for all scores, timers, and live activity metrics to create a 'Live Status' vibe.
Design the Marketplace with a 2-column grid and prominent search. Product cards should focus heavily on the image, title, price, and a single tag.
Wallet UI should use a carousel of cards for active rewards, focusing on visible progression and essentialist redemption screens.
RSVP toggles on schedule cards should be interactive segmented controls on the card itself, providing instant haptic feedback.
Integrate Light and Dark modes seamlessly across all surfaces, ensuring Dark mode utilizes elevated surface (surfaceSecondary/Tertiary) lightness rather than just heavy borders.
Do not use emojis in system UI or navigation elements. Stick to the chosen Phosphor icon set.
